packageRules.description: Track only STABLE upstream Tailscale (even minor version, per tailscale's release convention); never an unstable v1.99.x.

customManagers.description: Track the tailscale source pin against upstream tailscale/tailscale release tags. A REF bump (e.g. v1.102.0 -> v1.104.0) waits for ci.yml (platformAutomerge:false) before auto-merge, then release-on-bump.yml auto-cuts the MM tag (forward-only).
Track the mavericks-golang cross toolchain pin. It lives in a FILE, not a workflow env line, so a bump is a path repackage-on-ingredient-bump.yml can watch and turn into a -mavericks.(N+1) repackage.
